description: Source profile for rig_transfer.py: the Carl Johnson model of GTA San Andreas as the 3ds Max ASCII FBX 6.1 export (CarlJohnson-GTASA.FBX). The model itself is not in the repository; pass its path with --source-file. 'up' and 'forward' are the model's own axes, 'roles' name the model's bones for the body parts the tool matches, 'textures' give the picture of every material (file names as they are written into the glb after --texture-uri).
name: CJ
